final: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS num_executions, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions e2 JOIN orders o2 ON e2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) AS fraction FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase
